mods.name: Child Friendly Keep Inventory
mods.description: Per-player keepInventory, controlled entirely by operators. Overrides the vanilla keepInventory gamerule for players: each player's own setting (or the configured default) decides whether they keep items and XP on death, regardless of the gamerule.

releases.notes:
Per-player keepInventory for Fabric servers, controlled entirely by operators.

Install: drop child_friendly_keepinventory-1.0.0.jar into your server's mods/ folder together with Fabric API (0.154.0+26.2 or newer). Server-side only, players don't need anything.

Requirements: Minecraft 26.2 (Java), Fabric Loader >= 0.19.3, Java 25.

Commands (op level 2):
/ikeepinv set <player> <true|false> - per-player override (name, selector, or UUID; works for players who never joined)
/ikeepinv get <player>
/ikeepinv clear <player>
/ikeepinv default [<true|false>] - fallback for players without an override
/ikeepinv list

The vanilla keep_inventory gamerule is ignored for players, the per-player setting always wins. Settings persist in config/child_friendly_keepinventory/settings.json, keyed by UUID. See the README for details and edge cases.
